definitions.AfAv: A(lambda)/A(V) at lambda = WavelengthPivot from the extinction law (see extinction); dimensionless
definitions.Fsun: band-averaged f_lambda of the Sun at 1 AU, integral(W S) / integral(W) with S the sun_spectrum and W the curve's detector-aware weight (T energy-counting, T*lambda photon-counting), trapezoidal rule on the curve's samples: the weight of ZeroPointVega_flam
definitions.colors: DisplayColor is an sRGB hex for plotting (sed_tools.filter_colors). ColorMethod 'true': CIE D65 daylight seen through the curve, for bands with VisibleFraction (share of the throughput between 380 and 750 nm) of at least 0.5; 'false': ordered false colour for ultraviolet and infrared bands.

extinction.law: Fitzpatrick (1999) Milky Way R(V)-dependent extinction curve
extinction.normalisation: A(V) is the law's own normalisation, the extinction averaged over the V band: A(lambda)/A(V) = 1 at 5414 Angstrom and 0.978 at 5500 Angstrom (https://dust-extinction.readthedocs.io/en/latest/dust_extinction/normalization_details.html)
extinction.out_of_range: null where the pivot lies outside the implementation's F99.x_range; never extrapolated
extinction.quantity: AfAv = A(lambda)/A(V) at the pivot wavelength

definitions.note: Vega quantities are null when the Vega spectrum does not cover the curve (where it transmits at least 1 % of its peak), Fsun likewise with the sun_spectrum. AfAv is null where the pivot lies outside the extinction law's valid range, or when dust_extinction is not installed (extinction.dust_extinction_version is then null).

references: Bohlin, Gordon & Tremblay 2014, PASP 126, 711 (2014PASP..126..711B, doi:10.1086/677655): CALSPEC
Colina, Bohlin & Castelli 1996, AJ 112, 307 (doi:10.1086/118016): the solar reference spectrum
sun_spectrum.spectrum: CALSPEC sun_reference_stis_002 below 9600 Angstrom, sun_mod_001 from 9600 Angstrom (sun/README.md)
sun_spectrum.units: WAVELENGTH Angstrom (vacuum), FLUX erg/s/cm2/Angstrom at 1 AU
